نتوايل (form VI)
# نَتَوَايَلُ (natawāyalu) /na.ta.waː.ja.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَوَايَلَ (tawāyala)
# نَتَوَايَلَ (natawāyala) /na.ta.waː.ja.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَوَايَلَ (tawāyala)
# نَتَوَايَلْ (natawāyal) /na.ta.waː.jal/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَوَايَلَ (tawāyala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
